title: Fix sutra_dead auto-exclusion for test helpers and integration test files
description: sutra/13 added auto-exclusion for #[test] functions and #[cfg(test)] modules, but integration test files (tests/*.rs) and helper functions within test files/modules still appear in dead output. Three tool-side fixes available.

acceptance_criteria.text: Exclude all symbols from integration test files (tests/*.rs) from sutra_dead output
Propagate cfg(test) flags to child items — helper fns inside #[cfg(test)] mod tests should be excluded
Non-#[test] helper functions in test files (setup_db, make_config, sym) excluded via file-level exclusion
MCP-registered tool handlers remain a pack-side filtering concern (not a sutra fix)
